title: Heritage short storyboard
description: The contract between every pipeline stage. Each stage reads this file and writes to outputs/.

version.description: Bump when the story changes after a user test, e.g. v1 -> v2

style_block.description: Appended to every image prompt to keep the look consistent

characters.description: Character sheet: the same description is injected into every prompt that uses the character

reference_image.description: Path to the approved golden reference, set after the reference-sheet stage

fallback_models.description: Tried in order when the main model's daily quota is used up

style.description: Plain-language delivery instruction, e.g. calm, warm, unhurried

mode.description: per_line: one TTS call per shot (cheap re-takes, but the tone can change between lines). one_take: the whole narration in one call, cut into shots at the pauses (one continuous voice, 1 call; changing any line regenerates the whole take). See EXPERIMENTS E5

chosen.description: Path to the chosen score; null means use placeholder music

caption.description: ACE-Step caption: style, mood, instruments, texture

intent.description: What the music should do emotionally (spotting note)

use_references.description: false = describe the characters in text only, without sending their reference images (EXPERIMENTS E11)

image_prompt.description: Subject and setting; style_block and character descriptions are added by the keyframes stage

motion_prompt.description: Only motion and camera; the keyframe already holds the subject

narration.description: Line spoken over this shot; empty string for a silent beat. Also the subtitle text

tts_text.description: Optional: what the TTS is given instead of `narration`, e.g. a phonetic spelling of a name. Subtitles still use `narration`. See EXPERIMENTS E4

min_duration_s.description: Shot is at least this long, longer if its narration needs it
